exam.title: Professional Cloud Architect
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; Google recommends three or more years of industry experience including at least one year designing and managing Google Cloud solutions. Practice requirements-to-decision traceability, the six Well-Architected pillars, hybrid/multicloud migration, service/data/network/AI selection, security/compliance evidence, repeatable delivery, cost/change/skills governance, observability, release, recovery and production resilience using the four official case studies.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Designing and planning a cloud solution architecture (~25%)
Managing and provisioning a cloud solution infrastructure (~17.5%)
Analyzing and optimizing technical and business processes (~15%)

review.notes: All six current domains and the cross-cutting six-pillar Well-Architected baseline are mapped through requirements, tradeoffs, provisioning, security/compliance evidence, technical/business processes, implementation and production operation. The four official V6.1 cases get a reusable fact-to-decision method; three additional scenarios, eight labs and 36 checks reinforce it. All 13 URLs are cataloged: 12 reachable and O'Reilly automation-blocked; none missing or broken. No proprietary question bank, recalled item or copied course content is used.

findings.title: Missing lifecycle snapshot is initialization rather than exam change
findings.evidence: Canonical objective digest unchanged and previous status digest absent; page provides standard and distinct renewal routes.
findings.recommendation: Initialize reviewed lifecycle baseline, preserve before/accepted/post observations and distinguish standard versus renewal case scope.
findings.resolution: Initialize reviewed lifecycle baseline, preserve before/accepted/post observations and distinguish standard versus renewal case scope.

findings.title: A retained integration and availability target constrain EHR design
findings.evidence: EHR explicitly does not plan to move legacy insurance interfaces now and requires minimum99.9% customer-facing availability without a stated RTO.
findings.recommendation: Add retain/hybrid decision and require separate SLI/window/recovery targets rather than inventing an RTO.
findings.resolution: Add retain/hybrid decision and require separate SLI/window/recovery targets rather than inventing an RTO.

findings.title: Human review is part of the publication contract
findings.evidence: Cymbal requires associates to approve,reject or modify generated content before catalog update.
findings.recommendation: Separate proposal and publication; bind approval to exact content/source version and demonstrate stale/changed approval rejection in a limited local model.
findings.resolution: Separate proposal and publication; bind approval to exact content/source version and demonstrate stale/changed approval rejection in a limited local model.

findings.title: Case constraints and executive assertions need different evidentiary treatment
findings.evidence: Dealer equipment has no new budget while vehicle hardware changes and degraded connectivity are separate requirements; safety claim is part of a fictional executive statement.
findings.recommendation: Distinguish dealer versus vehicle modernization and require independent simulation/validation/approval evidence for real safety claims.
findings.resolution: Distinguish dealer versus vehicle modernization and require independent simulation/validation/approval evidence for real safety claims.

findings.title: Restore duration alone does not establish business RTO
findings.evidence: End-to-end planning includes deployment artifacts,capacity,identity,security,access and recovery tests.
findings.recommendation: Add explicit dependency graph and original68minute versus53minute planning examples; neither is a measured recovery result.
findings.resolution: Add explicit dependency graph and original68minute versus53minute planning examples; neither is a measured recovery result.

findings.title: Regional HA and asynchronous regional DR have different failure contracts
findings.evidence: Regional loss, cross-region lag,clientredirection,oldprimarysplitbrain and restoringHA/replicas all affect recovery.
findings.recommendation: Teach engine/edition/topology-specific failover and distinguish controlled catch-up switchover from outage failover.
findings.resolution: Teach engine/edition/topology-specific failover and distinguish controlled catch-up switchover from outage failover.

findings.title: PSC feature choice changes initiation direction and reachable paths
findings.evidence: Endpoints/backends serve consumerinitiated access; interfaces support producerinitiated connections and can reach connected consumer networks.
findings.recommendation: Record feature/direction,service support,DNS and actual authorization instead of treating all private networking as interchangeable.
findings.resolution: Record feature/direction,service support,DNS and actual authorization instead of treating all private networking as interchangeable.

findings.title: Dry-run violations are observations rather than enforced protection
findings.evidence: Proposed violations log without those denials; existing enforced configuration still applies separately.
findings.recommendation: Separate rehearsal from enforcement and require exercised positive/negative path evidence.
findings.resolution: Separate rehearsal from enforcement and require exercised positive/negative path evidence.

findings.title: Key rotation does not have one universal managed-service effect
findings.evidence: CMEK integrations use three patterns for new/existing data;directKMSrotation alone does not rewrite ciphertext.
findings.recommendation: Check exact resource and backup dependencies before retiring old versions; add separate rotation versus rewrapping teaching.
findings.resolution: Check exact resource and backup dependencies before retiring old versions; add separate rotation versus rewrapping teaching.

findings.title: Attestation and vulnerability evidence are separate controls
findings.evidence: Attestations certify successful required processes under policy; scanning and admission contribute distinct evidence.
findings.recommendation: Teach signer/digest/process,scanage,severityexceptions,enforcement and later runtime reassessment instead of treating signature as universal safety proof.
findings.resolution: Teach signer/digest/process,scanage,severityexceptions,enforcement and later runtime reassessment instead of treating signature as universal safety proof.

findings.title: A low-traffic source example has inconsistent burn-rate arithmetic
findings.evidence: Source text says one failed request among10 at99.9% SLO is1000x; the stated formula gives0.1/0.001=100x,also consistent with13.9%monthlybudget perhour. Direct cached and web page passages verified.
findings.recommendation: Display100x explicitly and execute it locally; retain multiwindow/lowtraffic concepts without blindly repeating a numeric misprint.
findings.resolution: Display100x explicitly and execute it locally; retain multiwindow/lowtraffic concepts without blindly repeating a numeric misprint.
